authority.quickSummary: Derived from the canonical normalized rule text; not RAW.

contract.identity: sourcebook + canonical tree + canonical talent name
contract.canonicalDescription: Normalized, source-backed full rules text for the exact Scum publication identity.

Draw Fire is only a cross-tree reference inside Misplaced Loyalty; the Disgrace tree publishes six talents.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever anyone concealed by your use of the Force Haze talent attacks, you maintain total concealment without having to make another Use the Force check. Only those who do not attack remain concealed; the attacker no longer has total concealment, even when using this talent.
records.quickSummary: Whenever anyone concealed by your use of the Force Haze talent attacks, you maintain total concealment without having to make another Use the Force check.
records.repoBenefit: Whenever anyone concealed by your use of the Force Haze Talent attacks, you maintain Total Concealment without having to make another Use the Force check. Only those who do not attack remain concealed; the attacker no longer has Total Concealment, even when using this Talent.
records.repoDescription: Whenever anyone concealed by your use of the Force Haze Talent attacks, you maintain Total Concealment without having to make another Use the Force check. Only those who do not attack remain concealed; the attacker no longer has Total Concealment, even when using this Talent.

records.canonicalDescription: During a surprise round, before combat begins, if you are not surprised you can give up your standard action to allow all nonsurprised allies within your line of sight to take an extra move action during the surprise round. Allies can spend this move action to instead reroll their Initiative check and take the better result as a free action before combat begins.
records.quickSummary: During a surprise round, before combat begins, if you are not surprised you can give up your standard action to allow all nonsurprised allies within your line of sight to take an extra move action during the surprise round.
records.repoBenefit: If you are not surprised, you may forgo your standard action so non-surprised allies in line of sight gain an extra move or may reroll Initiative and keep the better result.
records.repoDescription: If you hit an opponent that has not yet acted in combat, deal +2 dice of damage.

records.canonicalDescription: You deliver a scathing rebuke against a target to erode its will and fill it with doubt. Make a Persuasion check as a standard action against the target's Will Defense. If successful, impose a -2 penalty to all the target's Defenses until the end of your next turn. You can use this ability only against targets that can clearly hear you and understand your language.
records.quickSummary: You deliver a scathing rebuke against a target to erode its will and fill it with doubt.
records.repoBenefit: Make Persuasion vs Will Defense to impose -2 to all of the target’s defenses until the end of your next turn.
records.repoDescription: Make a Persuasion check vs Will Defense to impose -2 to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a standard action, you can grant a tactical advantage to all allies within your line of sight. When any ally flanks an opponent, that ally gains a +4 flanking bonus on melee attack rolls instead of the normal +2 bonus. Allies lose this benefit immediately if line of sight is broken, if you are unconscious or dead, or at the end of the encounter.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a standard action, you can grant a tactical advantage to all allies within your line of sight.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, allies in line of sight gain +4 flanking bonus to melee attacks.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, allies in line of sight gain a +4 flanking bonus to melee attacks.

records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action once per turn, you can make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of all opponents within your line of sight. If successful, a target cannot attack you if one of your allies is within 6 squares of you. You may not use this talent in the same round as the soldier's Draw Fire talent. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: As a swift action once per turn, you can make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of all opponents within your line of sight.
records.repoBenefit: Once per turn, make Persuasion vs Will Defense against all opponents in line of sight; the chosen target cannot attack you or one ally within 6 squares.
records.repoDescription: Once per turn, a Persuasion check prevents enemies in line of sight from attacking you or one ally.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action. False Security: Make a single melee or ranged attack against a target within range; any time before the beginning of your next turn, you can make a single attack against that target as a reaction if that target attacks you. Nonthreatening: Make a single melee or ranged attack against a target within range; until the beginning of your next turn, that opponent cannot make any attacks against you except attacks of opportunity; this is a mind-affecting effect. Tricky Target: Make a single melee or ranged attack against a target within range that has not attacked you since the end of your last turn; you gain a +2 bonus on your attack roll and damage roll for this attack.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, attack to set up a retaliatory strike, become nonthreatening, or gain +2 attack and damage against a target that ignored you.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter after you attack: if you use the same attack, you may attack as a reaction; or an opponent cannot attack you; or gain +2 attack if they haven't attacked.
records.repoDescription: After you attack, choose one benefit affecting enemy attacks or your own attack rolls.

records.canonicalDescription: You gain a +5 bonus to your Will Defense against skill checks made to read your emotions and influence your attitude. In addition, whenever you successfully feint a target in combat, that target is flat-footed against all your attacks until the end of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: You gain a +5 bonus to your Will Defense against skill checks made to read your emotions and influence your attitude.
records.repoBenefit: +5 Will Defense vs checks to read your emotions; when you feint in combat, the target is flat-footed against you.
records.repoDescription: Gain +5 Will Defense against checks to read your emotions; feinted enemies are flat-footed.

records.canonicalDescription: Your allies hold you in such esteem that when you are threatened or injured, you can impel them to action. You can use each of the following actions once per encounter. Guardian: Choose one ally as a swift action. As long as you remain within 6 squares of the ally, you gain a +2 bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. Reprisal: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any target within range as a standard action. If your attack roll succeeds and that target attacks you before the end of your next turn, one ally within 6 squares can make an attack against that target as a reaction. To Me!: Spend a swift action. Whenever you take any damage before the beginning of your next turn, each ally within line of sight can move 2 squares as a reaction; this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, use Guardian for +2 Reflex, Reprisal to enable an ally's reaction attack, or To Me! to let visible allies reposition when you take damage.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter: an ally within 6 squares gains +2 Reflex as a swift action; or when you attack and are attacked, the ally makes a free attack; or when attacked, allies in line of sight move 2 squares as a reaction.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, grant an ally a Reflex bonus, a free attack, or allow allies to reposition as reactions.
records.notes: Repository Guardian summary reverses the beneficiary: the source gives the character +2 Reflex while near the chosen ally; it does not give the ally +2 Reflex.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can turn a critical hit against you into a normal hit.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can turn a critical hit against you into a normal hit.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, turn a critical hit against you into a normal hit.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, turn a critical hit against you into a normal hit.

records.canonicalIdentity: Scum and Villainy|Fortune|Better Lucky than Dead
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you gain a +5 luck bonus to any one defense until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you gain a +5 luck bonus to any one defense until the start of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, gain +5 bonus to one defense until the start of your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action. Elude Enemy: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any target within range; if you damage the target, you gain a +2 bonus to your Reflex Defense against that target until the beginning of your next turn. Escape: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any target within range; if the target successfully damages you before the start of your next turn, you can immediately move 2 squares as a reaction without provoking attacks of opportunity. Make your Own Luck: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any target within range; if you miss this target, you gain a +2 bonus on your next attack roll.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, use Dumb Luck to gain Reflex against a damaged target, escape after being damaged, or gain +2 on your next attack after a miss.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter after you attack: if you damage the target, gain +2 Reflex Defense against them; or if you are damaged, move 2 squares; or if you miss, gain +2 on your next attack.
records.repoDescription: After you attack, gain a situational bonus depending on whether you hit, miss, or are damaged.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you become immune to all mind-affecting effects until the end of your next turn. You can choose to ignore this for beneficial effects. Any mind-affecting effects currently affecting you are also removed, though you may choose to retain any beneficial effects.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you become immune to all mind-affecting effects until the end of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, you become immune to mind-affecting effects until your next turn; the effect ends early if you choose to lose it.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, become immune to mind-affecting effects until your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: When making a ranged attack against a target with cover, you can choose to reduce the benefit of that target's cover by one step, from improved cover to cover or cover to no cover. You deal only half damage with this attack.
records.quickSummary: When making a ranged attack against a target with cover, you can choose to reduce the benefit of that target's cover by one step, from improved cover to cover or cover to no cover.
records.repoBenefit: With a ranged attack, reduce the target’s cover by one step and deal half damage.
records.repoDescription: With a ranged attack, reduce a target's cover and deal half damage.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can consider any single d20 roll of 16 or higher to be a natural 20.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can consider any single d20 roll of 16 or higher to be a natural 20.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, any roll of 16 or higher is treated as a natural 20.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, a roll of 16 or higher is treated as a natural 20.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can reroll the damage of one attack and take the better result.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can reroll the damage of one attack and take the better result.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, reroll the damage of one attack.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, reroll the damage of one successful attack.

records.canonicalDescription: If you succeed on a Deception check against a target's Will Defense as a swift action, until the start of your next turn you can move through the threatened area of that target as a part of your move action without provoking an attack of opportunity. Each threatened square that you move through counts as 2 squares of movement.
records.quickSummary: If you succeed on a Deception check against a target's Will Defense as a swift action, until the start of your next turn you can move through the threatened area of that target as a part of your move action without provoking an attack of opportunity.
records.repoBenefit: Make Deception vs Will Defense to move through a threatened area without provoking attacks of opportunity; movement through the area counts as 2 squares.
records.repoDescription: Use Deception vs Will Defense to move through threatened squares without provoking attacks.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action. Create Opening: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any target within range; if you damage the target, it takes a -5 penalty to its Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. Crippling Attack: Make a single melee or ranged attack against an opponent within range; until the start of your next turn, the target takes a -2 penalty to its speed. Vicious Attack: Make a melee or ranged attack with one weapon against two opponents that are within 2 squares of each other; make a separate attack roll at a -5 penalty against each target, but roll damage only once.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, attack to impose -5 Reflex, reduce speed by 2, or attack two nearby targets at -5 while rolling damage once.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter after you attack: if you damage the target, impose -5 Reflex; or reduce the target’s speed by 2; or against two opponents within 2 squares, each takes -5 attack but you roll damage once.
records.repoDescription: After you attack, impose penalties or bonuses based on positioning.
records.notes: Repository Vicious Attack summary changes the mechanic: the source imposes -5 on the character's two attack rolls, not a -5 attack penalty on the targets.

records.canonicalDescription: You can fill your opponent with doubt by making a Persuasion check as a standard action against a single target that can hear and understand you within 12 squares. If your check result equals or exceeds the target's Will Defense, the target takes a -2 penalty to its base speed, and if the target takes a standard action it must also spend its swift action. This penalty lasts until the end of the target's next turn.
records.quickSummary: You can fill your opponent with doubt by making a Persuasion check as a standard action against a single target that can hear and understand you within 12 squares.
records.repoBenefit: Make Persuasion vs Will Defense within 12 squares; target’s speed is -2 and must spend a swift action with their standard action until their next turn.
records.repoDescription: Use Persuasion vs Will Defense to reduce an enemy's speed and actions.

records.canonicalDescription: When you move at least 2 squares before your attack and end your move in a different square from where you started, you gain a +1 bonus to all your defenses until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: When you move at least 2 squares before your attack and end your move in a different square from where you started, you gain a +1 bonus to all your defenses until the start of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If you move at least 2 squares and end in a different square, gain +1 to all defenses.
records.repoDescription: After moving and changing squares, gain +1 to all defenses.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a standard action, you can make a Deception check and compare the result to the Will Defense of all enemies in your line of sight. If the check result equals or exceeds an enemy's Will Defense, that enemy must spend a swift action in addition to a standard action to make an attack until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a standard action, you can make a Deception check and compare the result to the Will Defense of all enemies in your line of sight.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, make Deception vs Will Defense against a target in line of sight; target must spend a swift action with their standard action to attack until your next turn.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, force a target to spend a swift action to attack.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you would gain the benefit of the Skirmisher talent and you successfully hit your opponent, you deal sneak attack damage in addition to the normal damage dealt by the attack.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you would gain the benefit of the Skirmisher talent and you successfully hit your opponent, you deal sneak attack damage in addition to the normal damage dealt by the attack.
records.repoBenefit: Deal sneak attack damage when you use Skirmisher.
records.repoDescription: Deal Sneak Attack damage when using Skirmisher.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you deal damage to an opponent denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, you can choose not to move the target down the condition track and instead impose a -5 penalty on all your opponent's attacks and melee damage until the end of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you deal damage to an opponent denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, you can choose not to move the target down the condition track and instead impose a -5 penalty on all your opponent's attacks and melee damage until the end of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If you deal damage to an opponent denied Dexterity to Defense, you may impose -5 to attack and melee damage instead of moving them down the condition track.
records.repoDescription: Instead of moving an enemy down the condition track, impose attack and damage penalties.

records.canonicalDescription: You can substitute a Use Computer check for a Mechanics check when disabling a computerized device. The effort takes 1 minute and the DC is equal to the computer's Will Defense. In addition, whenever anyone accesses the affected computer using a droid or another computer, that computer or droid's attitude immediately becomes unfriendly.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Electronic Sabotage, trained in Use Computer
records.quickSummary: You can substitute a Use Computer check for a Mechanics check when disabling a computerized device.
records.repoBenefit: Substitute Use Computer for Mechanics to disable a computerized device; 1 minute vs Will Defense; device becomes unfriendly.
records.repoDescription: Disable a computerized device using Use Computer or Mechanics.

records.canonicalDescription: When adjacent to an obstacle or barrier, you gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense.
records.quickSummary: When adjacent to an obstacle or barrier, you gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense.
records.repoBenefit: +2 Reflex Defense when adjacent to an obstacle or barrier.

records.canonicalIdentity: Scum and Villainy|Spacer|Make a Break for It
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, while on or in a vehicle, you can move up to one-half your speed or move the vehicle up to one-half its speed if you are the pilot, as a swift action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, while on or in a vehicle, you can move up to one-half your speed or move the vehicle up to one-half its speed if you are the pilot, as a swift action.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, move up to half your speed on a vehicle, or half the vehicle’s speed if you are the pilot, without provoking attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, move without provoking attacks of opportunity while aboard a vehicle.

records.canonicalIdentity: Scum and Villainy|Camouflage|Hide in Plain Sight
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, when you are within 2 squares of cover or concealment, you can move to that cover or concealment and make a Stealth check to hide as a single move action.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, when you are within 2 squares of cover or concealment, you can move to that cover or concealment and make a Stealth check to hide as a single move action.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, if within 2 squares of cover or concealment, move to it and make a Stealth check as a single move action.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, move into cover or concealment and make a Stealth check as a single move action.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you benefit from cover, you can spend a swift action to hunker down and maximize the benefit of the cover. You increase the benefit of cover to improved cover and improved cover to total cover.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you benefit from cover, you can spend a swift action to hunker down and maximize the benefit of the cover.
records.repoBenefit: If benefiting from cover, increase cover by one step.
records.repoDescription: Increase the benefits of cover by one step.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action. Blinding Strike: Make a single melee or ranged attack against an opponent within range; if you damage the target, you gain total concealment against that target until the beginning of your next turn. Confusing Strike: Make a single melee or ranged attack against an opponent within range; if the opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense or you have concealment from this opponent, a successful attack also causes the opponent to be able to take only a swift action on its next turn. Unexpected Attack: Make a melee or ranged attack within range against an opponent from whom you have concealment; you gain a +2 bonus on this attack roll if you have concealment or a +5 bonus if you have total concealment.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, attack from stealth to gain total concealment, restrict a target to one swift action, or gain +2/+5 on the attack.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter after you attack: if you deal damage, gain total concealment vs that target; or if the opponent lacks Dex to Defense or you are concealed and deal damage, the target can only take a swift action next turn; or if you have concealment, gain +2 attack (+5 with total concealment).
records.repoDescription: After attacking, gain concealment or deny Dexterity to Defense based on circumstances.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can designate a single opponent and move up to your speed away from that opponent. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from that opponent, though it might provoke as normal from all other opponents. In addition, your speed increases by 2 until the end of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can designate a single opponent and move up to your speed away from that opponent.
records.repoBenefit: Designate a single opponent and move away: +2 speed; no attacks of opportunity from that opponent.
records.repoDescription: Move away from a designated opponent at increased speed without provoking attacks.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully jury-rig a device or vehicle, the vehicle does not move -5 steps along the condition track at the end of the encounter, though it does move -2 persistent steps down the condition track.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully jury-rig a device or vehicle, the vehicle does not move -5 steps along the condition track at the end of the encounter, though it does move -2 persistent steps down the condition track.
records.repoBenefit: When you jury-rig a vehicle, it moves -2 down the condition track at end (instead of -5).
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, your vehicle avoids moving down the condition track.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Keep It Together
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: Once per encounter your vehicle avoids moving down the condition track.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Once per encounter, your vehicle avoids moving down the condition track.

records.notes: Repository benefit is broadly source-aligned, but its description incorrectly says the vehicle simply avoids moving down the condition track once per encounter.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use a swift action to reduce the cost of each move into a diagonal space to 1 until the end of your turn if you are wearing light armor or no armor. You cannot use this talent if you are wearing medium or heavy armor.
records.quickSummary: You can use a swift action to reduce the cost of each move into a diagonal space to 1 until the end of your turn if you are wearing light armor or no armor.
records.repoBenefit: Reduce diagonal movement cost to 1 if in light or no armor.
records.repoDescription: Diagonal movement costs only 1 square when in light or no armor.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can use a swift action to move up to your speed.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can use a swift action to move up to your speed.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, move up to your speed.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, move up to your speed.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action. Blurring Burst: As a move action move up to your speed and gain a +2 bonus to your Reflex Defense until the end of the encounter. Sudden Assault: Make a charge attack against an enemy within range as a standard action; you take no penalty to your Reflex Defense for this attack. Weaving Stride: Move up to your speed as a move action; you gain a cumulative +2 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense for each attack of opportunity made against you during this movement, lasting until the beginning of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter, move for a lasting Reflex bonus, charge without the Reflex penalty, or build Reflex bonuses from attacks of opportunity during movement.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter: move your speed and gain +2 Reflex until end of encounter; or no Defense penalty on a charge; or move and gain +2 Reflex vs attacks of opportunity until your next turn.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, move your speed and gain defensive bonuses.

records.canonicalDescription: While flanked, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack rolls and damage rolls.
records.quickSummary: While flanked, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack rolls and damage rolls.
records.repoBenefit: When flanked, gain +2 on unarmed attack rolls and damage.
records.repoDescription: If flanked, gain +2 on unarmed attack and damage rolls.

records.canonicalDescription: When you fight defensively, any adjacent creature that attacks you provokes an attack of opportunity from you.
records.quickSummary: When you fight defensively, any adjacent creature that attacks you provokes an attack of opportunity from you.
records.repoBenefit: When you fight defensively, any adjacent creature that attacks provokes an attack of opportunity from you.
records.repoDescription: When you fight defensively, adjacent enemies provoke attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: You can use each of the following actions as a standard action once per encounter. Avoid Attack: Make a single melee attack against an opponent within your reach. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a +5 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against a single attack as a reaction. Fortified Mind: Make a single melee attack against an opponent within your reach. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to Fortitude or Will Defense against a single attack as a reaction. Focused Stance: Make a single melee attack against an opponent within your reach. At any time before the beginning of your next turn, as a reaction, you can move up to 2 squares; this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Once each per encounter after a melee attack, gain +5 Reflex, gain +5 Fortitude/Will, or move 2 squares safely as a reaction.
records.repoBenefit: Each once per encounter after you attack: gain +5 dodge bonus; or +5 Fortitude or +5 Will Defense; or move 2 squares without provoking.
records.repoDescription: After attacking, gain +5 dodge, +5 Fortitude or Will Defense, or move 2 squares without provoking attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: When fighting with an improvised weapon, you take no penalty on your attack rolls.
records.quickSummary: When fighting with an improvised weapon, you take no penalty on your attack rolls.
records.repoBenefit: No penalty when using improvised weapons.
records.repoDescription: You take no penalty when using improvised weapons.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever an ally within 6 squares is reduced to 0 hit points, you can immediately move up to your speed toward that ally as a reaction. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Whenever an ally within 6 squares is reduced to 0 hit points, you can immediately move up to your speed toward that ally as a reaction.
records.repoBenefit: If an ally within 6 squares is reduced to 0 hit points, move up to your speed toward the ally without provoking attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: When an ally within 6 squares is reduced to 0 hit points, move up to your speed toward them without provoking attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: During the surprise round, you and all allies within 6 squares of you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls. Additionally, until the end of the encounter, you retain this bonus to attack rolls against any target you or your allies damage during the surprise round.
records.quickSummary: During the surprise round, you and all allies within 6 squares of you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls.
records.repoBenefit: During the surprise round, you and allies within 6 squares gain +1 attack; you retain the +1 attack against targets you damage.
records.repoDescription: During a surprise round, you and allies within 6 squares gain +1 attack; you retain the bonus against damaged targets.

records.canonicalDescription: When your melee attack damages an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, that opponent cannot make attacks of opportunity until the end of its next turn.
records.quickSummary: When your melee attack damages an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, that opponent cannot make attacks of opportunity until the end of its next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If your melee attack damages an opponent denied Dexterity to Defense, that opponent cannot make attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: If your melee attack damages an opponent denied Dexterity to Defense, that opponent cannot make attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully damage an opponent using a bludgeoning weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your next attack against that opponent made before the end of the encounter gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll and to the damage roll. The effects of multiple Crushing Assaults do not stack.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully damage an opponent using a bludgeoning weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your next attack against that opponent made before the end of the encounter gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll and to the damage roll.
records.repoBenefit: If you damage an opponent with a bludgeoning attack, gain +2 attack and +2 damage on your next attack against that opponent before the end of the encounter.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully damage an opponent using a piercing weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your opponent reduces its speed by 2 squares until the end of your next turn. The effects of multiple Impaling Assaults do not stack.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully damage an opponent using a piercing weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your opponent reduces its speed by 2 squares until the end of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If you damage an opponent with a piercing attack, the opponent’s speed is -2 until the end of your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully injure an opponent using a slashing weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your opponent takes a -2 penalty on melee attacks against you until the start of your next turn. The effects of multiple Stinging Assaults do not stack.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully injure an opponent using a slashing weapon that you have the Weapon Specialization talent for, your opponent takes a -2 penalty on melee attacks against you until the start of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If you damage an opponent with a slashing attack, the opponent takes -2 melee attack until your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: If you occupy the same space as a vehicle that is larger than the vehicle you are piloting, your vehicle gains a +5 cover bonus from the larger vehicle.
records.quickSummary: If you occupy the same space as a vehicle that is larger than the vehicle you are piloting, your vehicle gains a +5 cover bonus from the larger vehicle.
records.repoBenefit: If you occupy the same space as a larger vehicle, gain +5 cover bonus.
records.repoDescription: While occupying the same space as a larger vehicle, gain a +5 cover bonus.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you use the all-out movement action as the pilot of a vehicle, your vehicle gains a +2 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you use the all-out movement action as the pilot of a vehicle, your vehicle gains a +2 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
records.repoBenefit: When you take an all-out movement as the pilot, gain +2 Reflex Defense.
records.repoDescription: When using all-out movement as the pilot, gain +2 Reflex Defense.

records.canonicalDescription: If you are the pilot of a vehicle, smaller vehicles that attempt to engage you in a dogfight take a -10 penalty on their Pilot check instead of the normal -5.
records.quickSummary: If you are the pilot of a vehicle, smaller vehicles that attempt to engage you in a dogfight take a -10 penalty on their Pilot check instead of the normal -5.
records.repoBenefit: When you pilot a vehicle, smaller vehicles attempting to dogfight take a -10 penalty instead of -5.
records.repoDescription: When piloting a vehicle, smaller vehicles attempting to dogfight you take a –10 penalty instead of –5.

records.canonicalDescription: When you are the pilot of a Colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ship weapons that take a -20 penalty on attack rolls against your vehicle, such as turbolasers, do not automatically score a critical hit on your vehicle on a natural 20. The attack is only a critical hit if the total attack roll (20 + the weapon's attack bonus) would normally hit your vehicle. Otherwise, the attack deals normal damage.
records.quickSummary: When you are the pilot of a Colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ship weapons that take a -20 penalty on attack rolls against your vehicle, such as turbolasers, do not automatically score a critical hit on your vehicle on a natural 20.
records.repoBenefit: If you pilot a colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ships take -20 to attack (not -10) and cannot score critical hits unless you would be hit.
records.repoDescription: When piloting a Colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ships take –20 on attack rolls and cannot score critical hits unless they would hit normally.

records.canonicalDescription: You can move into or through a space occupied by a vehicle of Colossal (frigate) size or larger without causing a collision. Additionally, if you pilot a Colossal or smaller vehicle, you can occupy the same space as a vehicle of Colossal (frigate) size or larger.
records.quickSummary: You can move into or through a space occupied by a vehicle of Colossal (frigate) size or larger without causing a collision.
records.repoBenefit: You can move into the same space as a frigate or larger without collision and may occupy the same space.
records.repoDescription: You may move into the same space as a frigate-sized or larger vehicle without collision and occupy the same space.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can instill bone-chilling fear in an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target. Make a Persuasion check against your opponent's Will Defense. If you equal or exceed your opponent's Will Defense, that opponent takes a -5 penalty to Will Defense. This is a mind-affecting effect. The penalty remains as long as you have line of sight to your opponent and immediately ends if the line of sight is broken.
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can instill bone-chilling fear in an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target.
records.repoBenefit: Make Persuasion vs Will Defense against your Hunter's Target to impose -5 to their Will Defense as long as you keep line of sight.
records.repoDescription: Make a Persuasion check vs Will Defense; your Hunter's Target takes –5 Will Defense while you maintain line of sight.

records.canonicalIdentity: Scum and Villainy|Bounty Hunter|Nowhere to Run
records.canonicalDescription: Once per turn, whenever an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target attempts to withdraw, you can make an attack of opportunity against the opponent.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Hunter's Mark, Hunter's Target, Nowhere to Hide
records.quickSummary: Once per turn, whenever an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target attempts to withdraw, you can make an attack of opportunity against the opponent.
records.repoBenefit: Once per turn when your Hunter's Target attempts to withdraw, you may make an attack of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: Once per turn, if your Hunter's Target attempts to withdraw, you may make an attack of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you damage an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target, all allies gain a +2 bonus on their next attack roll against that opponent until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you damage an opponent whom you selected for Hunter's Target, all allies gain a +2 bonus on their next attack roll against that opponent until the start of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: If you damage your Hunter's Target, all allies gain +2 on their next attack vs that target until the start of your next turn.
records.repoDescription: When you damage your Hunter's Target, allies gain +2 attack on their next attack against it.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes performing rituals that enhance your connection with the Force, receiving visions and portents as a result. At that time, you can spend any number of Force Points in the performance of the ritual, up to the total number you have remaining. For the remainder of the day, whenever you make a Perception or Stealth check, make a Use the Force check to use the farseeing Force power, or make an attack roll, you can choose to reroll but must keep the second result, even if it is worse. You may do this a number of times per day equal to the number of Force Points you spent during the casting of the ritual. At the end of the day, you regain Force Points equal to the number of rerolls you have remaining.
records.quickSummary: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes performing rituals that enhance your connection with the Force, receiving visions and portents as a result.
records.repoBenefit: Once per day, spend a Force Point for a 10-minute ritual to reroll Perception, Stealth, Farseeing, or an attack roll and regain unspent Force Points.
records.repoDescription: Once per day, spend 10 minutes and a Force Point to reroll key checks and regain unspent Force Points.

records.canonicalDescription: The visions you receive sometimes provide clues about dangerous situations. Whenever you make a Perception check to avoid surprise, you may roll two dice and keep the better result.
records.quickSummary: The visions you receive sometimes provide clues about dangerous situations.
records.repoBenefit: Roll two dice for Perception to avoid surprise and keep the better result.
records.repoDescription: Roll twice on Perception checks to avoid surprise and keep the better result.

records.canonicalDescription: You see omens in both success and failure. Whenever an ally within 10 squares and line of sight rolls a natural 1 or a natural 20 on an attack roll, you gain a +2 insight bonus to either your next attack roll made before the end of your next turn, or a +2 insight bonus to Reflex Defense until the end of your next turn, your choice.
records.quickSummary: You see omens in both success and failure.
records.repoBenefit: When an ally within 10 squares and line of sight rolls a natural 1 or 20, you gain +2 attack or +2 Reflex Defense until the end of your next turn.
records.repoDescription: When an ally rolls a natural 1 or 20, gain +2 attack or +2 Reflex Defense until the end of your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: You have visions that tell you what your enemies are likely to do even before they do it. Once per encounter, when an enemy creature moves within 6 squares of you, you may make a melee or ranged attack against that target as a reaction to their movement.
records.quickSummary: You have visions that tell you what your enemies are likely to do even before they do it.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter when an enemy moves within 6 squares, you may make an attack against them as a reaction.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, when an enemy moves within 6 squares, make an attack as a reaction.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a reaction to any enemy's attack, you can move up to your speed.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a reaction to any enemy's attack, you can move up to your speed.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter when attacked, you can move your speed as an immediate reaction.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter when attacked, move your speed.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a reaction to one of your minions being moved down the condition track, you can reduce the number of steps the minion moves down the condition track by 1. Additionally, the target regains hit points equal to your heroic level. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points or moved to the bottom of the condition track, you cannot use this talent on that target.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Attract Minion, Inspire Fear I, Inspire Fear II
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a reaction to one of your minions being moved down the condition track, you can reduce the number of steps the minion moves down the condition track by 1.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter if a minion is down the track, you may reduce them by 1 and the target regains hit points equal to your heroic level unless at 0 hp.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, if a minion moves down the condition track, reduce it by 1 and the minion regains hit points equal to your heroic level.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can designate a minion as a free action to spread fear among your enemies. At any point before the end of the encounter, you can activate this ability to force all enemies adjacent to your minion to move 1 square away from the minion. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This is a mind-affecting effect.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can designate a minion as a free action to spread fear among your enemies.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter force all enemies to move 1 square away from one minion; they cannot make attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, force all enemies to move 1 square away from one of your minions without provoking attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can make a Persuasion check against a target that is within your line of sight and that is also affected by your Inspire Fear talent. If you equal or exceed the target's Will Defense, then on its next turn the target must spend at least one move action to move away from you. If the target is somehow prevented from doing so, then the penalty from Inspire Fear doubles until the start of your next turn. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Frighten, Inspire Fear I, Inspire Fear II
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can make a Persuasion check against a target that is within your line of sight and that is also affected by your Inspire Fear talent.
records.repoBenefit: Persuasion vs Will in line of sight forces targets to move away from you; if they cannot move, fear effect doubles.
records.repoDescription: Make a Persuasion check vs Will Defense; affected targets must move away from you or suffer doubled fear effects if unable to move.

records.canonicalDescription: Any opponent that is reduced to half hit points or fewer while within 6 squares of you takes a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and skill checks for the duration of the encounter. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Inspire Fear I, Inspire Fear II, Inspire Fear III, Notorious
records.quickSummary: Any opponent that is reduced to half hit points or fewer while within 6 squares of you takes a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and skill checks for the duration of the encounter.
records.repoBenefit: When an opponent is reduced to half hit points within 6 squares of you, they take -2 to attack and skill checks for the rest of the encounter.
records.repoDescription: When an opponent is reduced to half hit points within 6 squares, they take –2 attack and skill checks for the rest of the encounter.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you are adjacent to a minion gained with the Attract Minion talent, once per turn as a reaction to being attacked you can redirect the attack against that minion. Compare the attack roll to the minion's defenses and resolve the attack as normal.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you are adjacent to a minion gained with the Attract Minion talent, once per turn as a reaction to being attacked you can redirect the attack against that minion.
records.repoBenefit: Once per turn, redirect an attack to an attracted minion.
records.repoDescription: Once per turn, redirect an attack to one of your attracted minions.

records.canonicalDescription: When you redirect an attack to a minion using the Bodyguard I talent, that minion's relevant defense score gains a bonus equal to half your class level.
records.quickSummary: When you redirect an attack to a minion using the Bodyguard I talent, that minion's relevant defense score gains a bonus equal to half your class level.
records.repoBenefit: Once per turn, redirect an attack to an attracted minion; the minion gains Reflex Defense equal to half your class level.
records.repoDescription: Once per turn, redirect an attack to a minion; the minion gains Reflex Defense equal to half your class level.

records.canonicalDescription: When you redirect an attack to a minion using the Bodyguard I talent, that minion can make an immediate melee or ranged attack against your attacker if the attacker is within range. Additionally, the bonus provided by the Bodyguard II talent increases to your full class level.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Attract Minion, Bodyguard I, Bodyguard II
records.quickSummary: When you redirect an attack to a minion using the Bodyguard I talent, that minion can make an immediate melee or ranged attack against your attacker if the attacker is within range.
records.repoBenefit: Once per turn, redirect an attack to an attracted minion; the minion gains Reflex Defense equal to your class level and makes a free attack against the attacker.
records.repoDescription: Once per turn, redirect an attack to a minion; the minion gains Reflex Defense equal to your class level and makes a free attack against the attacker.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can spend three swift actions on consecutive turns to grant one ally the ability to take a standard action and a move action. The ally must act immediately on your turn when the final swift action is spent, before you do anything else, or the opportunity is wasted.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Impel Ally I, Impel Ally II
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can spend three swift actions on consecutive turns to grant one ally the ability to take a standard action and a move action.
records.repoBenefit: Designated ally can take a standard and a move action immediately or the effect is wasted.
records.repoDescription: An ally may immediately take both a move and standard action or lose them.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can designate a target to be the object of your allies' wrath. While your allies have line of sight to the target or until the target is unconscious or dead, your allies gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls against the target and a +2 morale bonus on skill checks against that target. You can designate a new target on any round by using another standard action. You can only use this talent against one opponent at a time.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Impel Ally I, Impel Ally II
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can designate a target to be the object of your allies' wrath.
records.repoBenefit: Allies in line of sight gain +2 attack and +2 to skill checks against your designated target.
records.repoDescription: Allies in line of sight gain +2 attack and skill checks against your designated target.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you are adjacent to a minion, you gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you are adjacent to a minion, you gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense.
records.repoBenefit: Any cover bonus to your Reflex Defense is +2 when adjacent to a minion.
records.repoDescription: If adjacent to a minion, any cover bonus you receive is increased by +2 Reflex Defense.

records.canonicalDescription: Spend two swift actions to select two allies. Each ally can move 2 squares as a reaction. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Spend two swift actions to select two allies.
records.repoBenefit: Any cover bonus to your Reflex Defense is +2 when adjacent to a minion.
records.repoDescription: If adjacent to a minion, any cover bonus you receive is increased by +2 Reflex Defense.

records.canonicalDescription: Spend two swift actions to grant all allies that are in your line of sight and within 6 squares of you the ability to use the withdraw action as a swift action until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Spend two swift actions to grant all allies that are in your line of sight and within 6 squares of you the ability to use the withdraw action as a swift action until the start of your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: All allies in line of sight and within 6 squares may withdraw as a swift action until the start of your next turn.
records.repoDescription: All allies in line of sight and within 6 squares may withdraw as a swift action until the start of your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you can spend three swift actions on consecutive turns to increase the speed of all allies within line of sight of you by 2. The increased speed lasts until the start of your next turn after the third swift action is spent.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Impel Ally I, Impel Ally II, Impel Ally III
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, you can spend three swift actions on consecutive turns to increase the speed of all allies within line of sight of you by 2.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, increase the speed of allies in line of sight by 2.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, increase the speed of allies in line of sight by 2 squares.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever one of your minions is killed, he or she is replaced by another minion of the same level. This replacement occurs 24 hours later.
records.quickSummary: Whenever one of your minions is killed, he or she is replaced by another minion of the same level.
records.repoBenefit: If a minion is killed, they are replaced by one of the same level after 24 hours.
records.repoDescription: If a minion is killed, it is replaced by another of the same level after 24 hours.

records.canonicalDescription: If you are within 6 squares of a target and are armed with a pistol or a rifle, you can act as though you occupied the nearest square adjacent to the target for the purposes of determining whether or not you or any allies are flanking that target. You may only be considered to be flanking a single target at range at a time. You must spend a swift action on your turn to designate the target you flank at range.
records.quickSummary: If you are within 6 squares of a target and are armed with a pistol or a rifle, you can act as though you occupied the nearest square adjacent to the target for the purposes of determining whether or not you or any allies are flanking that target.
records.repoBenefit: If within 6 squares of the target, you can count as adjacent for flanking against a single target.
records.repoDescription: If within 6 squares of a target, you may be treated as adjacent for purposes of flanking that target.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter as a full-round action, when you are wielding two pistols, you may move up to twice your speed and make a ranged attack with each pistol. The normal penalties for attacking with two weapons apply to these attacks.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Dual Weapon Mastery I, Running Attack
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter as a full-round action, when you are wielding two pistols, you may move up to twice your speed and make a ranged attack with each pistol.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter with two pistols, move twice your speed and make attacks with each pistol.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, while wielding two pistols, move up to twice your speed and make one attack with each.
records.repoPrerequisites: Dual Weapon Mastery I, Running Attack

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you are flanked by two or more opponents and are wielding two pistols, you can make a full attack action as a standard action instead of a full-round action. This is provided that you target only opponents that flank you and attack at least two targets.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you are flanked by two or more opponents and are wielding two pistols, you can make a full attack action as a standard action instead of a full-round action.

records.canonicalDescription: If you are wielding two pistols and make a single ranged attack with one of those pistols as a standard action, even if you miss you deal damage equal to half your heroic level to the target. This consumes a single shot from the weapon not making the attack, and the weapon you attack with uses as many shots as required by the attack.
records.quickSummary: If you are wielding two pistols and make a single ranged attack with one of those pistols as a standard action, even if you miss you deal damage equal to half your heroic level to the target.
records.repoBenefit: With two pistols, even if you miss, deal damage equal to half your heroic level.
records.repoDescription: When attacking with two pistols, even if you miss, deal damage equal to half your heroic level.

records.canonicalDescription: When you are wielding two pistols, as a standard action you can make an autofire attack with one of the pistols as though the weapon were set to autofire, even if the pistol would not normally be capable of autofire. The normal penalties for autofire still apply to this attack roll, and you may split the number of shots consumed between the two pistols.
records.quickSummary: When you are wielding two pistols, as a standard action you can make an autofire attack with one of the pistols as though the weapon were set to autofire, even if the pistol would not normally be capable of autofire.
records.repoBenefit: With two pistols, attack as if autofire even without autofire, applying autofire penalties.
records.repoDescription: When wielding two pistols, you may attack as if using autofire; autofire penalties apply.

records.canonicalDescription: When you are wielding two pistols, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls when using the Rapid Shot feat.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Dual Weapon Mastery I, Rapid Shot
records.quickSummary: When you are wielding two pistols, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls when using the Rapid Shot feat.
records.repoBenefit: With two pistols and Rapid Shot, gain +2 damage.
records.repoDescription: When using Rapid Shot with two pistols, gain +2 damage.
records.repoPrerequisites: Dual Weapon Mastery I, Rapid Shot

records.canonicalDescription: Any opponent that you are flanking is considered flat-footed and is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against you.
records.quickSummary: Any opponent that you are flanking is considered flat-footed and is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against you.
records.repoBenefit: An opponent you flank is treated as flat-footed.
records.repoDescription: An opponent you flank is considered flat-footed.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter as a standard action you can make a melee attack against a target and then move your speed away from that target. This movement does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter as a standard action you can make a melee attack against a target and then move your speed away from that target.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, make a melee attack then move your speed away without provoking attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, make a melee attack and then move your speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: When your successful attack causes an opponent to move -1 step along the condition track, that opponent immediately takes an additional 1d6 damage.
records.quickSummary: When your successful attack causes an opponent to move -1 step along the condition track, that opponent immediately takes an additional 1d6 damage.
records.repoBenefit: If you move an opponent down the condition track, they take +1d6 damage.
records.repoDescription: When you move an opponent down the condition track, they take +1d6 damage.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully hit an opponent that you have marked, your melee and ranged attacks deal an additional die of damage.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully hit an opponent that you have marked, your melee and ranged attacks deal an additional die of damage.
records.repoBenefit: If you hit an opponent you have marked, deal +1d6 damage.
records.repoDescription: When you hit a marked opponent, deal +1d6 damage.
records.notes: Repository changes '+1 die of damage' to '+1d6 damage'.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, when you drop a foe to 0 hit points or push an opponent to the bottom of the condition track, you can immediately take a bonus standard action.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, when you drop a foe to 0 hit points or push an opponent to the bottom of the condition track, you can immediately take a bonus standard action.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, if you drop a foe to 0 hp or to the bottom of the track, you gain an extra standard action.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, when you reduce a foe to 0 hit points or the bottom of the track, gain a bonus standard action.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Ruthless
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: When you deal damage over the target’s threshold, gain +2 damage against that target for the rest of the encounter.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Once per encounter, when you reduce a foe to 0 hit points or the bottom of the track, gain a bonus standard action.

records.canonicalDescription: As a move action, you can move 1 square without provoking an attack of opportunity.
records.quickSummary: As a move action, you can move 1 square without provoking an attack of opportunity.
records.repoBenefit: Move 1 square without provoking attacks of opportunity.
records.repoDescription: Move 1 square without provoking attacks of opportunity.

records.canonicalDescription: When you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you add half your class level to your damage roll.
records.quickSummary: When you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you add half your class level to your damage roll.
records.repoBenefit: When making a ranged attack not at point-blank range, add half your class level to damage.
records.repoDescription: When making a ranged attack outside point-blank range, add half your class level to damage.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, when you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you can ignore your target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, when you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you can ignore your target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter when making a ranged attack not at point-blank range, ignore the target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, ignore the target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense on a ranged attack outside point-blank range.

records.canonicalDescription: By taking only a single swift action, you can aim at a target that is not within point blank range.
records.quickSummary: By taking only a single swift action, you can aim at a target that is not within point blank range.
records.repoBenefit: Aim with one swift action at a target not in point-blank range.
records.repoDescription: You may aim at a target outside point-blank range using only a swift action.

records.canonicalDescription: When you reduce a target to 0 hit points or move the target to the bottom of the condition track, all your opponents within line of sight of both you and your target take a -2 penalty on attack rolls until the beginning of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: When you reduce a target to 0 hit points or move the target to the bottom of the condition track, all your opponents within line of sight of both you and your target take a -2 penalty on attack rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Deadly Repercussions
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: When you reduce an opponent to 0 hp, all opponents in line of sight of you and the target take -2 attack until your next turn.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: When you reduce an opponent to 0 hit points, all enemies in line of sight take –2 attack until your next turn.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per turn when you successfully damage a target with a non-area attack, make an immediate Persuasion check against the target's Will Defense. If successful, you can determine what the target does with its swift action on its next turn. This is a mind-affecting effect.
records.quickSummary: Once per turn when you successfully damage a target with a non-area attack, make an immediate Persuasion check against the target's Will Defense.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Manipulating Strike
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: Once per turn, when you damage a target with a non-area attack, make Persuasion vs Will Defense to control that target's swift action.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Once per turn, after damaging a target, make a Persuasion check to determine their next swift action.

records.notes: No correct-tree Scum and Villainy record exists. Same-name candidate(s) belong to another canonical or obsolete tree identity and must not be repaired by display name alone.

records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully use the Manipulating Strike talent, you determine what the target does with its move action on its next turn. You cannot move an opponent into a hazard such as lava or off a cliff.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully use the Manipulating Strike talent, you determine what the target does with its move action on its next turn.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Improved Manipulating Strike
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: Once per turn, when you damage a target with a non-area attack, make Persuasion vs Will Defense to control that target's move action.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Once per turn, after damaging a target, make a Persuasion check to determine their next move action.

records.notes: No correct-tree Scum and Villainy record exists. Same-name candidate(s) belong to another canonical or obsolete tree identity and must not be repaired by display name alone.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of a target within 12 squares. If you succeed, you move the target up to half its speed toward what you determine is the safest route, and you can make an immediate ranged or melee attack against the target if it is within your range. You cannot move an opponent into a hazard such as lava or off a cliff.
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of a target within 12 squares.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Pulling the Strings
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: Make Persuasion vs Will Defense within 12 squares to move the target half its speed toward you and make an immediate attack.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Use Persuasion vs Will Defense to move a target toward you and force an immediate attack.

records.notes: No correct-tree Scum and Villainy record exists. Same-name candidate(s) belong to another canonical or obsolete tree identity and must not be repaired by display name alone.

records.canonicalDescription: When you successfully feint an opponent in combat, you can immediately move up to one-half your speed as a reaction.
records.quickSummary: When you successfully feint an opponent in combat, you can immediately move up to one-half your speed as a reaction.
records.repoBenefit: If you feint in combat, you may move half your speed as part of the feint.
records.repoDescription: When you feint in combat, you may move up to half your speed.

records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can make a Deception check against the Will Defense of any target within your line of sight that can see, hear, and understand you. If successful, the next attack made by one of your allies against that target deals 2 additional dice of damage.
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can make a Deception check against the Will Defense of any target within your line of sight that can see, hear, and understand you.
records.repoBenefit: After a successful Deception vs Will Defense in line of sight, the next attack by your ally against that target deals +2 dice of damage.
records.repoDescription: After a successful Deception check vs Will Defense, the next attack by your ally against the target deals +2 dice damage.

records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as a reaction to one of your allies being attacked, you can make a Deception check, replacing the defense score of that ally with the result of your Deception check for resolution of the attack. If any defense score is higher than the Deception check result, your ally can use that defense score instead. If the attack still hits, this does not count as the one use per encounter of this talent.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as a reaction to one of your allies being attacked, you can make a Deception check, replacing the defense score of that ally with the result of your Deception check for resolution of the attack.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter when an ally is attacked, your Deception check can substitute for their defense; if it fails, the effect is not used.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, when an ally is attacked, your Deception check replaces their Defense; if the check fails, the talent is not expended.

records.canonicalDescription: While you occupy a square adjacent to another creature, you can use a swift action to gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn or until you are no longer adjacent to another creature, whichever comes first.
records.quickSummary: While you occupy a square adjacent to another creature, you can use a swift action to gain a +2 cover bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn or until you are no longer adjacent to another creature, whichever comes first.
records.repoBenefit: If adjacent to a creature, gain +2 Reflex Defense until you are no longer adjacent or until your next turn.
records.repoDescription: If adjacent to another creature, gain +2 Reflex Defense until your next turn or until no longer adjacent.

records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, you can make a Deception check against a single enemy within 6 squares of you and in line of sight.
